entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A Dominarian necromancer and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who keeps her own lodging, hides her resentment of Jace, and steers Chandra and the group.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker of the Gatewatch from Kaladesh who was raised by monks on Regatha, and whose parents were renegades; she is awkwardly drawn to Nissa.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who is also the Ravnican Guildpact, swamped with paperwork and hosting the team in his house.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A hieromancer from Theros and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who is indestructible when ready for a blow and acts as battlefield commander.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elven animist from Zendikar and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who is overwhelmed by Ravnica and mourns her lost bond with Zendikar.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: An Azorius guard who attends Jace as Guildpact, anticipates his needs, and has been sworn to secrecy about planeswalkers.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A tall vedalken Minister of Inspections for the Consulate of Kaladesh who asks the Gatewatch to root out renegades threatening the Inventors' Fair and reveals Chandra's parents.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A renegade luminary and, per Baan, Chandra's mother, reported dead after the Bunarat manhunt.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: A renegade luminary and, per Baan, Chandra's father, reported dead after the Bunarat manhunt.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A soratami scholar of Kamigawa who helped defeat Emrakul and passes word among planeswalkers on behalf of the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Mother Luti
entities.description: A monk from Chandra's upbringing who taught the log-burning ritual about being consumed by divinity.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The leader of a criminal Consortium for which Liliana and Jace once worked.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan the Gatewatch defeated and sealed in Innistrad's silver moon.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The alliance of five planeswalkers formed to protect worlds from threats from beyond, now headquartered in Jace's house.

entities.name: Consulate of Kaladesh
entities.description: The unified, centralized, meritocratic government of Kaladesh that Baan represents.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: A movement against the Consulate accused of sabotage and theft of aether resources.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild leadership whose influential members were petrified by a gorgon assassin.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: A Kaladeshi festival in Ghirapur with expositions of artifice and grants, disrupted by vandals.

entities.name: Jace's house
entities.description: Jace's Ravnican home with a vast library, a gymnasium and a roof garden, where the Gatewatch lives.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the Gatewatch lives, overwhelming Nissa with its noise and crowds.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane of inventors and brass cities, home of Baan and Chandra's birthplace.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home world, whose voice she can no longer hear in her mind.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: The place where Chandra was raised with monks and rituals.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the Gatewatch defeated Emrakul.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The capital city of Kaladesh where the Inventors' Fair is held and where Chandra grew up near.

entities.name: Bunarat
entities.description: A village set ablaze during the manhunt for the Nalaars.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: The artifact Liliana keeps hidden in a pocket, possessed by whispering Onakke spirits.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: Energy in the air of Kaladesh that the Consulate siphons and stores in devices.

entities.name: Leylines
entities.description: Natural magic patterns in the land of Zendikar that Nissa perceives and manipulates.

events.summary: Liliana wakes a hungover Chandra at noon in Jace's house.
events.quote: Morning, Liliana

events.summary: Liliana guesses Chandra spent the night at the Izzet air races.
events.quote: You went to see the Izzet air races.

events.summary: Liliana notes Nissa has barely left the roof garden since the first morning.
events.quote: She's been staying in the roof garden ever since.

events.summary: Liliana explains she keeps her own lodgings because she dislikes relying on others, hiding that she will not sleep under a roof Jace paid for.
events.quote: I mislike relying on the mercy of others

events.summary: In the courtyard Nissa conjures a bush-beast that drives Gideon into the ground, testing his indestructibility.
events.quote: Its front limbs interlaced into a single fist, which it drove down on Gideon like an avalanche.

events.summary: Gideon asks Nissa if his habit of clapping shoulders makes her uncomfortable and promises to stop.
events.quote: That thing I do, where I clap people on the shoulder? Does that make you uncomfortable?

events.summary: Liliana bristles that Nissa gets apologies while she once had to learn to break fingers.
events.quote: Two hundred years ago, she'd had to learn to break fingers.

events.summary: Liliana reflects that Jace swore Lavinia to secrecy about planeswalking, and Lavinia guards him to keep him from leaving.
events.quote: to swear her to secrecy

events.summary: Liliana makes Jace drop his tidy glamour, revealing him tired and unkempt.
events.quote: You can drop the glamour, dear. No one cares.

events.summary: Jace explains he has put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.
events.quote: I've put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.

events.summary: Jace introduces Dovin Baan, a Minister of Inspections from Kaladesh, as the first to seek out the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Our guest is Dovin Baan.

events.summary: Baan presents himself as a representative of the Consulate of Kaladesh and describes its unified system.
events.quote: I have the honor of coming before you as an officially and duly designated representative of the Consulate of Kaladesh.

events.summary: Baan explains that the Inventors' Fair preparations have been disrupted by vandals.
events.quote: preparations have been repeatedly disrupted by vandals and malcontents

events.summary: Gideon realizes Baan wants the Gatewatch to provide security and hunt the renegades.
events.quote: So, to be clear, you want the Gatewatch to provide...security?

events.summary: Chandra storms out of the meeting furious at Baan's description of the renegades.
events.quote: Chandra's chair tilted over backward as she bolted to her feet.

events.summary: Baan asks who makes decisions for the group, and Jace and Gideon each fumble to name a leader.
events.quote: Gideon is the battlefield commander...

events.summary: Liliana tells Baan the Gatewatch handles outside threats, not internal ones, so its hands are tied.
events.quote: our hands are tied.

events.summary: Baan accepts Liliana's reasoning and prepares to leave.
events.quote: I did not fully comprehend the strictures you operate under.

events.summary: Gideon invites Baan to stay for dinner and a tour of the headquarters.
events.quote: Minister, you should at least stay for dinner.

events.summary: Jace reveals influential Azorius Senate members were petrified while he was away.
events.quote: a few influential members in the Azorius Senate were...eliminated.

events.summary: Jace explains a planeswalking gorgon assassin with a grudge against the Azorius swore she would return.
events.quote: About a year ago, there was a gorgon assassin operating on Ravnica.

events.summary: Jace asks Gideon to investigate the petrifications and work with the Azorius.
events.quote: I'd like you to investigate this.

events.summary: Liliana recalls that she and Jace once worked for Tezzeret's Consortium (backstory).
events.quote: when she and Jace had worked for Tezzeret's criminal Consortium

events.summary: Liliana feels the Chain Veil in its hidden pocket and the whispering spirits inside it.
events.quote: She laid a hand over the hidden pocket where she kept the Chain Veil.

events.summary: Jace tells Liliana he hates it when she takes over, and she answers that she remembers when he enjoyed that.
events.quote: I remember when you enjoyed that.

events.summary: Chandra rages that the Consulate killed Kaladesh's best inventors as she punches Gideon's punching bag.
events.quote: They killed the best damn inventors on Kaladesh.

events.summary: Gideon's punching bag bursts into flames and Chandra puts it out with a bucket, leaving a sand pile.
events.quote: The canvas of Gids's punchybag bursts into flames.

events.summary: Chandra wonders whether she belongs and thinks of returning to Regatha.
events.quote: I should go back to Regatha.

events.summary: Chandra remembers floating in green when she touched Nissa's mind and is drawn to seek her out.
events.quote: She was floating in green and I could breathe there.

events.summary: Chandra finds Nissa sitting on moss in her flower-filled room.
events.quote: She's sitting cross-legged on a patch of moss.

events.summary: Chandra clumsily tells Nissa that on Zendikar she felt Nissa's calm mind behind the world's anger.
events.quote: But behind Zendikar, behind the anger and the power, I felt you

events.summary: Nissa offers to teach Chandra to meditate.
events.quote: I can teach you to meditate, if you wish.

events.summary: Mortified, Chandra flees Nissa's room.
events.quote: I turn and run, trailing sparks, trees and flowers smearing around me, banging through the door.

events.summary: Chandra rushes past Baan and Gideon, apologizing for blowing up the punching bag.
events.quote: SorryIblewupyourthingy

events.summary: Liliana finds Chandra hiding in an alley and persuades her to come along shopping.
events.quote: She was crouched halfway down an alley three blocks from Jace's home

events.summary: Liliana invites Chandra to join her and talk on the way.
events.quote: Then I suppose you'll have to come along and see.

events.summary: Nissa, daydreaming of waking as a seed in the dark, is jolted back by Gideon at dinner.
events.quote: I'm not a seed.

events.summary: Gideon tells Baan about what Nissa and Chandra did on Zendikar.
events.quote: I was telling Minister Baan what you did on Zendikar.

events.summary: Nissa feels overwhelmed and alone among the crowds of Ravnica, cut off from Zendikar's voice.
events.quote: She'd never been among so many, and never been so alone.

events.summary: Baan contrasts aether with leylines, and Nissa explains that on her world they ask rather than take.
events.quote: We don't take.

events.summary: Jace returns from his paperwork and Lavinia hands him tea, anticipating his needs.
events.quote: It's my job to anticipate you, Guildpact,

events.summary: Baan voices his deterministic view that a criminal will forever remain a criminal.
events.quote: A criminal will forever remain a criminal.

events.summary: Lavinia reports that Liliana and Chandra spent the afternoon in the market district and then planeswalked together.
events.quote: They spent the afternoon wandering the market district

events.summary: Baan recognizes Chandra's surname and reveals Pia and Kiran Nalaar were renegade luminaries.
events.quote: Pia and Kiran Nalaar were early luminaries of the renegade movement.

events.summary: Baan explains that Chandra's parents, hunted after she manifested pyromancy, were reported dead when Bunarat was set ablaze.
events.quote: the girl escaped custody when she manifested dangerous pyromantic abilities

events.summary: Gideon defends Chandra, saying her parents' sins have nothing to do with her.
events.quote: But her heart's the size of the moon.

events.summary: Nissa says Chandra's past was hers to share, since everyone has scars others should not touch.
events.quote: We all have scars we don't want others to touch.

events.summary: Lavinia stops Jace from leaving to find Chandra, saying Gideon and Nissa can search for Monk Nalaar.
events.quote: They can find Monk Nalaar.

events.summary: Nissa volunteers to go to Kaladesh with Baan and stand with Chandra.
events.quote: I'll stand with her.
